page_review.title: Low-Poly PSX Style Industrial Metal Doors Pack
page_review.author: Icevanilla
page_review.description: A pack of 6 low-poly PSX-style industrial metal doors for utility, service and industrial environments, with clean, worn, rusty, reinforced and heavy variants.
page_review.download_modal_terms: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.
page_review.visible_geometry: A row of industrial metal door variants including plain, windowed, worn and heavy leaves; the modeled Metal_Door_007 pair forms a double-leaf display and is excluded.
page_review.author_dependency_comment: The author says the model uses one texture atlas included with the FBX; local USDZ contains one atlas.

selected_source.operation: Keep only this source single-leaf group and its matching separate frame, when one is modeled; exclude the double-leaf display and other groups. Preserve the source meshes, UVs and packaged texture in a local selected USDC; leave the downloaded USDZ untouched.

license_dependency_review: One 1024 x 256 base-color atlas is packaged in the CC BY USDZ; stage metadata matches the page author, CC-BY-4.0 and source URL. No separate texture terms were found.
local_geometry_review: Single plain metal leaf, two-sided knobs and its own source U-frame; visually different atlas region from 003. This is not a distinct corpus identity from 003: the 12-triangle leaf, 44-triangle frame and 204-triangle knob geometry align rigidly (frame within 2 micrometers); only atlas appearance and about 9 mm vertical and 11 mm horizontal knob placement change.
duplicate_geometry_review: Aligned 003 and 005 source leaf vertices coincide to below 1 micrometer, knob mesh vertices coincide after rigid translation, and frame vertices coincide within 2 micrometers. Handle placement differs by about 9.2 mm vertically and 10.9 mm horizontally; the material atlas differs. This is near-identical structure, not a distinct door identity.
